item.content:encoded:
Greetings, Trovians!

The nights are getting darker, the shadows are creeping closer, and something spooky is lurking around the corner… BOO!

To celebrate the spookiest season of the year, we’re summoning all brave  builders for our Screamhouse Building Contest!

Whether you are eager to build a haunted mansion, a creepy castle, an abandoned asylum, a cursed graveyard, or a house so terrifying even the Shadow Hunters wouldn’t dare enter, it’s time to unleash your nightmares and give us a good scare—until Tuesday, 3 November 2026 11:00 am UTC!

How do I enter?

Head over to your Trove Cornerstone or Club and create a scream-worthy, spooky-themed build!

Take screenshots of your creation and post them on our Discord server in the screamhouse-building-contest channel.

Don’t forget the inside! You can also include a video tour of your Screamhouse to show us all the creepy rooms, spooky surprises, and terrifying details hiding within! We’ll be checking the interiors too, so make sure your Screamhouse is just as frightening on the inside as it is on the outside!

Include the following information in your submission:

• Character Name
• Platform (PC, XBOX, PSN, or SWITCH)
• Region (EU/NA)
• Entry Type (Cornerstone/Club)

Are there any rules?

• Your build can be created in a Cornerstone or Club.
• Only one entry is allowed per player.
• The structure must fit the spooky, haunted, horror, or Halloween theme.
• Both the exterior and interior of your Screamhouse will be considered during judging.
• A very minimal amount of image editing is allowed; however, the entire build must remain fully visible.
• Inappropriate or offensive content is strictly forbidden.
• Creations that you did not make or that do not belong to you are strictly forbidden.

And the rewards?

3,000 Credits for three (3) participants!

Grab your blocks, dust off those cobwebs, and let your imagination run wild! Remember, the real nightmares might be hiding behind closed doors…


By participating, you accept our General Terms of Participation apply

Something is watching, Trovians… and it has its eyes on YOU!

Greetings, Trovians! Halloween is creeping closer, and something mysterious is stirring in the shadows. Keep your eyes wide open, because an old familiar terror is making its return!

From 20 October, 11:00 AM UTC  until 3 November, 11:00 AM UTC, 2026, you can claim these eerie rewards. But don’t blink, Trovians! These spooky goodies won’t be lurking in the store forever!

Whether you’re looking to give your enemies the creeps or simply make a terrifying entrance, this pack has everything you need to embrace the spooky season in style.

Whether you’re exploring the darkest corners of Trove alongside Eyeless Qaw, keeping a watchful eye on your surroundings with Peepers and Stone Watcher, or riding into the unknown aboard Bloodsipper and Feast of Eyes, there’s no escaping the gaze of adventure!

And if you’re looking to dress for the occasion, the Chasm Captain and Unblinking Executioner costumes will make sure you’re a sight your enemies won’t soon forget!

Gather your fellow Trovians, embrace the darkness, and prepare for an adventure filled with mysterious creatures, watchful eyes, and Halloween surprises. After all, when Q’bthulhu returns, you never know what’s watching from the shadows!

item.dc:creator: Team Trove
item.description: Trovians, the veil between the living and the afterlife is growing thinner, and something sinister is lurking on the other side! From October 20 at 11:00 AM UTC until November 3, 2026 at 11:00 AM UTC, Shadow’s Eve returns to Trove with Lost Souls in need of help, mysterious creatures, and spooky rewards waiting to […]
item.content:encoded:
Trovians, the veil between the living and the afterlife is growing thinner, and something sinister is lurking on the other side!

From October 20 at 11:00 AM UTC until November 3, 2026 at 11:00 AM UTC, Shadow’s Eve returns to Trove with Lost Souls in need of help, mysterious creatures, and spooky rewards waiting to be discovered!

But this year, helping souls cross over won’t be enough. Q’bthulhu has set his sights on the veil, sending dark creatures to stop them from reaching the afterlife. It’s up to you to help Fiona Catastra protect the Lost Souls and prepare them for what lies ahead!

Here’s what awaits you:

Help the Lost Souls: Meet Wolfsly in the Hub, follow the event questline, and help wandering souls recover their lost memories, missing book pages, and broken instruments.

Face the Darkness: Explore Adventure Worlds, defeat Bad Souls, and collect Ghostly Light and Bad Soul Essence to craft powerful Soul Gear.

Protect the Afterlife: Equip Lost Souls with Soul Gear and defend them against waves of Chaos Creatures as they prepare to cross the veil.

Collect Spooky Rewards: Gather Chaos Essence to unlock new event collectibles, including the Ghostly Wheels mount, Curious Cauldron and Armored Andy allies, Soul Sentry costume, and Ghastly Gathering aura! You can also discover returning collectibles at the Shadowy Station.

The Lost Souls are counting on you, Trovian! Will you help them find peace, or will Q’bthulhu’s darkness claim them forever?

Grab your gear, brave the shadows, and help the Lost Souls cross over safely!

Your Trove Team!

item.content:encoded:
Greetings, Trovians!

October has arrived, bringing a mysterious atmosphere, spooky adventures, and a few surprises lurking in the shadows! Before we dive into the Halloween season, let’s look back at September, when Trovians went fishing with Books and Hooks, picked sides in Healthy Food vs. Junk Food, and returned to the arena with Trove: Rematch.

We also welcomed back a familiar dragon, but now something far more mysterious is approaching. Shadow’s Eve is returning, and the Lost Souls need your help once again!

Let’s take a look at what has been happening across Trove and what lies ahead!

Books and Hooks

Back-to-school season took an unexpected turn with Books and Hooks, where homework became fishing bait!

Trovians completed daily adventures, turned assignments into Soggy Homework, and cast their lines to catch eight special event fish. Along the way, players unlocked new helmet styles, donated their catches for rewards, and worked toward earning a special title.

Thanks to everyone who joined this unusual fishing adventure!

Healthy Food vs. Junk Food ’26

The tastiest rivalry in Trove returned, and this time, grapes stirred up even more trouble!

Trovians chose between Healthy Food and Junk Food, completed faction missions, and gathered pledges by winning over voters. With both sides competing for support, the Hub became the center of another delicious debate.

Thank you to everyone who joined the food feud and stood up for their favorite side!

Trove: Rematch – Now Live!

PvP made its long-awaited return with Trove: Rematch, bringing fresh battles and fierce competition to Trove!

The new Battle Mode introduced a home for Capture the Flag, Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch, and Bomber Royale. With updated matchmaking, rebalanced PvP stats, and Battle Coins to earn and spend on rewards, Trovians had plenty of reasons to jump back into the arena.

The battles have only just begun!

Duraveln – The Bamboo Dragon Returns!

A familiar dragon returned to the Forbidden Spires, giving Trovians another chance to welcome Duraveln, the Hollow Spirit!

We hope everyone enjoyed this chance to expand their dragon collections!

Shadow’s Eve 2026

Something spooky is stirring across Trove! Shadow’s Eve returns, and this year, the Lost Souls face a new threat as Q’bthulhu interferes with their journey beyond the veil.

Join Fiona Catastra to help wandering souls, gather Ghostly Light, and craft Soul Gear to protect them from dangerous Chaos Creatures.

Get ready to face the darkness and help the Lost Souls find their way!

1⃣Can we have a deep chat about Trove going source-code available (only partially. copyright and tos etc. remain), and the community fixing bugs, closing gaps, improving performance or creating content, which the devs can then review?

We appreciate the suggestion, however, making Trove’s source code available, even partially, would involve significant technical, legal, and security considerations. After evaluating these implications, this is not a direction we plan to pursue.

That said, we greatly value the community’s passion and willingness to help improve Trove. Player feedback remains an important part of our development process, and we encourage everyone to continue reporting bugs, suggesting improvements, and sharing ideas through our official support channels and community platforms.

2⃣Will building mode get reworked, like hovering mode similar to Minecraft to make building more enjoyable, new types of blocks/shapes/textures ?

Improving the building experience is in our plans. We recognize how important building is to Trove’s identity, and we want to make the process more accessible, intuitive, and enjoyable for players.

We are currently exploring the possibility of such a feature, and hope to bring it to you in 2027.

We would also love to hear more from the community about the creative possibilities you would like to see in Trove. Share your suggestions here #CommunityFeedback

3⃣Will there ever be more strict moderation about exploiters and cheaters, and will the player report system be more user friendly because its so inconvenient to use. Cuz the game is full of cheaters, so sad to see. Its so bad moderated that people start thinking its normal to use scripts, exploits and cheats

Yes. Stronger action against cheating, exploiting, and unauthorized scripts is a priority for us. Cheating is not, and never will be, an accepted part of Trove. 

We hear you, and we understand how frustrating it is to play alongside people who don’t play fair. It may not always be visible from the outside, but this is actively being worked on.

Here’s what that looks like:

  • Better detection: We’re strengthening our detection systems, moderation processes, and the infrastructure behind them, so violations are caught and handled consistently.
  • Easier reporting: We’re reworking the player report system to make it quicker and simpler to flag suspicious activity, and to help our team act on reports faster.
  • Real consequences: Using cheats, exploits, duping methods, or unauthorized scripts will be penalized, and that includes violations we uncover after the fact.

Thank you to everyone who keeps reporting. Your reports directly help us keep the game fair for everyone.

Do you want YOUR question answered in the next Community Letter?

Head to our Discord, where you’ll find a dedicated thread in the #feedback channel. Ask your questions and upvote the ones you would most like to see answered! The most upvoted questions will be answered by the game team in an upcoming Community Letter.

We look forward to seeing you in-game during the Elysian Initiation. Be sure to share your adventures with us, and until next time:

Facebook
X
Discord
Instagram
TikTok
Reddit
BlueSky

Happy adventuring, Trovians!

The Trove Team

item.content:encoded:
Get ready to show off your spookiest side, Trovians!

Halloween might be over, but the spooky fun isn’t! It’s time to dust off your scariest costumes, explore the eeriest corners of Trove, and capture a hauntingly good screenshot!

Whether you’re dressed as a terrifying monster, a mysterious witch, a wandering ghost, or something straight out of a nightmare, we want to see your creativity come to life!

For this special event, we’re inviting all Trovians to dress up in their favorite Halloween-inspired costumes and take a screenshot in their favorite spooky location in Trove.

From dark dungeons and mysterious landscapes to haunted castles and creepy corners, the choice is yours! You can even use your own creations and player-built locations as the backdrop for your Halloween masterpiece.

Find the perfect setting, strike a spooky pose, and show us your Halloween spirit!

Event Duration

October 14 – October 20, 2026 10:00 a.m. UTC

How to Participate

  1. Log into Trove and dress your character in your favorite Halloween costume.
  2. Explore Trove and find a spooky location, or create your own Halloween-inspired setting!
  3. Take an in-game screenshot featuring your costumed character in your chosen location.
  4. Head over to our official Discord server and submit your screenshot using the shared Photo-frame Template in #troves-spookiest-snapshot.

Make sure to include your Character Name and Platform (PC, Xbox, PS-EU, PS-NA, or Switch) with your submission.

Event Rules

  • Only one submission per player is allowed.
  • This is an individual event, and each submission must be posted by the participating player.
  • Multiple submissions from the same player will result in disqualification.
  • Screenshots must be taken in-game.
  • Your character must be clearly visible and wearing a costume.
  • Your screenshot must feature a spooky or Halloween-inspired location in Trove.
  • Player-built locations and personal creations are welcome!
  • Inappropriate or offensive content is strictly prohibited.

Raffle Rewards

Five lucky Trovians will be randomly selected to receive:

1,000 Credits each!

Winners Announcement

Winners will be announced after the event concludes. Stay tuned to our official channels to find out if you’re one of the lucky winners!

Ready to Get Spooky?

Whether you prefer haunted hideouts, eerie landscapes, or your own terrifying creations, we can’t wait to see what you come up with!

Put on your best costume, find your favorite spooky spot, and capture a Halloween memory worth sharing!

Good luck, Trovians, and may your screenshots be delightfully spooky!

By participating, you agree to our General Terms of Participation.
